title: Apply v2 — either way (loops)
music: Santigold - Disparate Youth (TikTok sound, starts at 'Don't look ahead'): bar = 1.5785 s, lift at 23.75 s

sections.text: People will call your business idea unrealistic, then apply to a company that started as somebody else's idea.
Since you were a kid it's been one plan. Good grades, college, get hired, climb. Nobody asks what you want to build.
Start something and suddenly everyone's an expert. Too risky. Be realistic. Get a real job.
And yeah, your first idea might flop. So might your second.
But the safe route isn't safe either. Someone else sets your hours, your pay, and when you get a day off.
Then one day the people who laughed are replying to your story, asking how you started.
So start anyway. Because either way,
